spec: SHARED crop-band fixtures — EXPLICIT-BAND contract (2026-09-09). Backend: oct_preprocess.resolve_crop_bands(crop_bands, n_lateral, n_frames) ; frontend: bandsAt(parseCropBands(crop_bands), lat). For every case and every key of `probes` (a probe lateral, as a string), the resolved bands at that lateral must EQUAL the listed [[lo, hi, id], ...] exactly — the bands COVERING that lateral, in ASCENDING band id, each with ITS OWN interpolated [lo, hi] (bands may overlap in frames and are NOT merged in this listing; a consumer that needs a frame set takes the union). RULES pinned here: (1) A BAND is {"id": <int>, "marks": {"<lateral>": [lo, hi]}} — at most ONE mark per lateral per band; lo/hi are swapped into lo <= hi; laterals outside [0, n_lateral) are dropped; lo/hi are CLAMPED into [0, n_frames-1]; invalid keys/values/bands are skipped; key/list order is irrelevant. (2) PERSISTED FORMS: explicit {"bands": [BAND, ...]} (ids unique, small positive ints); LEGACY {"<lateral>": [lo, hi]} is read as ONE band with id 1 and those marks; {} and {"bands": []} are no band; a band without a valid mark contributes nothing; the abandoned intermediate {"<lateral>": [[lo, hi], ...]} form is NOT a mark and is dropped. (3) INTERPOLATION per band, from ITS marks only: a band's lateral extent is exactly [min marked lateral, max marked lateral] of its marks; for each lateral x in that span, lo(x) and hi(x) are linear between the band's two nearest marked laterals (piecewise when it has a middle mark), rounded half-UP (Python floor(v + 0.5) == JS Math.round(v) for v >= 0), then clamped into [0, n_frames-1]; a single-mark band covers its lateral only. (4) Bands are INDEPENDENT: no linking, no grouping, no merging across bands — two bands with identical frames on adjacent laterals stay two bands, and nothing is cropped between two single-mark bands. (5) Unmarked/unspanned laterals are [].

cases.name: legacy_single_band_flat
cases.note: The pre-contract single-band map, marked on both boundary laterals → ONE band (id 1); every lateral in between carries the same band.

cases.name: legacy_single_band_sloped_half_up_rounding
cases.note: lo/hi interpolate linearly between the marked laterals; 22.5 -> 23 and 23.5 -> 24 (half-up, NOT banker's rounding); no crop outside [10, 20].

cases.name: explicit_single_band_equals_legacy
cases.note: The same marks in the explicit form resolve identically to the legacy case above.

cases.name: two_bands_overlapping_laterals_disjoint_frames
cases.note: Two bands on the same lateral span, disjoint in frames: each interpolates from its OWN marks. t=0.25 at lateral 20 (5.25 -> 5, 10.25 -> 10; 30.5 -> 31, 40.5 -> 41), t=0.5 at lateral 30 (5.5 -> 6, 10.5 -> 11; 31, 41).

cases.name: two_bands_same_frames_separate_lateral_spans
cases.note: Identical frame ranges on two separate lateral spans: two bands, nothing cropped between them (no auto-linking by frame overlap).

cases.name: two_bands_overlapping_in_both_union_at_shared_laterals
cases.note: Band 1 spans laterals 0-20 at frames 0-10, band 2 spans 10-30 at frames 8-15: on laterals 10-20 BOTH are listed, overlapping and unmerged (their union of frames there is 0-15, which is what _artifact_bands / the mask crop).

cases.name: single_mark_band
cases.note: A band with one mark covers its slice only.

cases.name: middle_mark_piecewise_interpolation
cases.note: Three marks on one band: lo/hi are linear between the two NEAREST marked laterals (piecewise), not a single line from first to last. Lateral 3 is t=0.3 of segment 0->10 (13, 23); lateral 20 is t=0.5 of segment 10->30 (10, 20); lateral 25 is t=0.75 (5, 15).

cases.name: slice_carrying_marks_of_two_bands
cases.note: Lateral 5 carries a mark of band 1 AND a mark of band 2; the bands have different lateral extents (band 1: 5-40, band 2: 5-15). Lateral 10 is t=0.5 of band 2 (21, 26).

cases.name: ids_preserved_and_listed_ascending
cases.note: Ids are whatever the writer chose (7 and 3 here, listed out of order in the file); the probes list the covering bands in ascending id.

cases.name: legacy_reversed_lo_hi_frame_clamp_unsorted_keys
cases.note: [9, 2] reads as [2, 9]; [35, 45] is clamped to [35, 39] for n_frames = 40; key order does not matter. Both marks belong to the ONE legacy band, so lateral 4 interpolates between them (18.5 -> 19, 24).

cases.name: legacy_invalid_entries_dropped
cases.note: A non-numeric key, a one-element value, a non-list value, an out-of-range lateral and the unsupported nested-list value are skipped; the valid mark survives as band 1.

cases.name: explicit_invalid_bands_dropped
cases.note: A band with no marks, a non-object entry, a band whose marks are all invalid/out of range, and a band without a marks key contribute nothing; the valid band survives with its own id.
